key.name: enable-auto-updates
key.description: If enabled, updates will be installed automatically instead of the user being prompted to install them.

key.name: initcheck-days
key.summary: The amount of days to wait before checking for updates upon system startup

key.name: initcheck-hrs
key.summary: The amount of hours to wait before checking for updates upon system startup

key.name: initcheck-mins
key.summary: The amount of minutes to wait before checking for updates upon system startup

key.name: repcheck-days
key.summary: The amount of days to wait checking for updates (after the initial check)

key.name: repcheck-hrs
key.summary: The amount of hours to wait checking for updates (after the initial check)

key.name: repcheck-mins
key.summary: The amount of minutes to wait checking for updates (after the initial check)
